jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Blue Mountain Union School District (District No. 21), a union (PK-12) district in the Orange East Supervisory Union (member towns Groton, Ryegate and Wells River village).
Orange East Supervisory Union (official site hosting the district's board page).

sources.note: Blue Mountain Union School District board page (Orange East Supervisory Union, official): nine directors with towns and terms -- Ryegate: Shawn Burroughs, James Jobin, Daniel LaCoss (Vice-Chair), Anna Morrison; Groton: Sasha Emerson, Megan Foy, Willis Page; Wells River: Kelsey Root-Winchester (Chair), Alissa Smith. The same nine sign the district's March 12, 2026 budget-vote warning. Directors are elected by their own member towns (16 V.S.A. section 706k(a)); the member town is Wells River village (in Newbury), not the whole town of Newbury, per the district's 2026 warning.
